title: feat(toolbar): extend list toggle to multi-line selections

reviews.body:
Thanks for the contribution. I found one correctness issue that should be fixed before merge.

1. `packages/plugin-toolbar/src/formatting.ts`: `getSelectedLines()` currently searches for the next newline starting at `to`, which makes the end of the selection behave as inclusive. A common editor selection like `[0, 4]` in `foo\nbar` means the user selected the first line and the caret is at column 0 of the second line; this implementation formats both `foo` and `bar`. Selections should be treated as half-open ranges, so a line whose start equals `to` should be excluded. Please add a regression test for this boundary.

2. This is a new toolbar behavior but the PR does not include an OpenSpec change. Please add the proposal/spec/tasks delta for the multi-line list toggle behavior and run `openspec validate <change-id> --strict`.

The existing toolbar test/build path passes locally (`pnpm vitest run packages/plugin-toolbar/test/plugin-toolbar.test.ts` and `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-toolbar build`), but the missing boundary case is user-visible.
